footer.tagline: Ubwikorezi n'ibikorwa bishingiye ku bantu, duhuza abagenzi, abashoferi n'imiryango muri Afurika no hanze yayo.

about.heroP1: Ntitwubaka urubuga rwo gutwara abantu gusa. Turimo kubaka urusobe rw'ikoranabuhanga rushingiye ku bantu, ruhuza abantu ku giti cyabo, ubucuruzi n'imiryango binyuze mu ngendo, mu bwikorezi no mu bisubizo bya digitale.
about.heroP2: Imbuga zacu zateguwe kugira ngo serivisi za buri munsi ziboneke byoroshye, ku giciro cyiza kandi mu buryo bunyuranye, mu gihe zinafungura amahirwe yo kwinjiza arambye ku bantu babarirwa muri za miliyoni.
about.beliefLead: Buri gicuruzwa twubaka kiyoborwa n'ihame rimwe ryoroshye:
about.beliefHighlight: Ikoranabuhanga rigomba guhanga amahirwe, ntiribe imbogamizi.
about.purposeBody: Gukorera abantu, guha imbaraga imiryango no guhanga amahirwe.

visionParts.text: Kuba urusobe rw'ingendo, ubwikorezi n'ikoranabuhanga rushingiye ku bantu rwizewe kurusha izindi ku isi, duhuza abakoresha barenga
kubona amahirwe yo kwinjiza arambye muri Afurika no hanze yayo.

about.missionBody: Inshingano yacu ni uguhindura uburyo abantu bagenda, bakora kandi bahuza, dutanga ibisubizo binyuranye by'ingendo, ubwikorezi n'ikoranabuhanga bishyira ububasha bwo gufata ibyemezo mu maboko y'abatanga serivisi, mu gihe abakiriya bahabwa agaciro kadasanzwe, umutekano, uburyo bworoshye n'amahitamo.
commitments: Guhanga imirimo n'amahirwe yo kwinjiza birenga miliyoni 5.
Gukorera abakoresha barenga miliyoni 500 ku isi.
Kubaka ikoranabuhanga rifasha bose kugera ku bukungu.
Gushyigikira ba rwiyemezamirimo n'ubucuruzi bwo mu karere.
Gutuma ingendo n'ubwikorezi biboneka, bihendutse kandi byizewe kuri bose.

values.title: Umukiriya mbere ya byose
values.body: Buri cyemezo gitangirana no gusobanukirwa no gukorera abakiriya bacu.

values.title: Ubwisanzure no guhinduka
values.body: Twizera ko akazi n'ingendo bigomba guhuzwa n'ubuzima bw'abantu, atari ukundi.

values.title: Guhabwa imbaraga binyuze mu mahitamo
values.body: Dushyira ububasha bwo gufata ibyemezo mu maboko y'abakiriya n'abatanga serivisi.

values.title: Ubukungu burimo bose
values.body: Duhanga inzira zituma abantu n'ubucuruzi binjiza, bakura kandi bagera ku ntsinzi hatitawe ku nkomoko cyangwa aho batuye.

values.title: Guhanga udushya nta mbibi
values.body: Duhora duhanga udushya kugira ngo dutange ibisubizo by'ubwenge, byihuse kandi binoze kurushaho.

values.title: Ikizere n'umucyo
values.body: Twubaka ikizere binyuze mu kuri, kubazwa ibyo dukora, ubutabera no gutumanaho mu mucyo.

values.title: Ingaruka nziza ku muryango
values.body: Intsinzi yacu ntipimwa gusa n'inyungu, ahubwo n'ingaruka nziza duteza mu miryango.

values.title: Indashyikirwa mu bikorwa
values.body: Duharanira indashyikirwa muri buri rugendo, buri bwikorezi, buri bufatanye no muri buri mubano n'umukiriya.

about.impactBody: Turimo kubaka rumwe mu nsobe z'ikoranabuhanga nini muri Afurika. Ruha imbaraga ba rwiyemezamirimo, abashoferi, ubucuruzi n'imiryango babarirwa muri za miliyoni binyuze ku mbuga za digitale z'udushya.
about.promiseBody: Dusezeranya kubaka ikoranabuhanga riboneka, rihendutse, ryizewe, rifite umutekano, ririmo bose kandi rishingiye ku muryango. Kuko iyo abantu babonye amahirwe, imiryango itera imbere.
about.communityMotto: Urugendo rwawe. Amahitamo yawe. Amahirwe yawe.

benefits.title: Byubatswe mu Rwanda
benefits.detail: Itsinda ryo mu gihugu, inzira zo mu gihugu, uburyo bwo kwishyura bwo mu gihugu. Tuzi uko u Rwanda rugenda.

steps.title: Ohereza amakuru yawe
steps.detail: Porogaramu iragufasha intambwe ku yindi. Ibisabwa byihariye ku kinyabiziga cyawe bigaragara muri iyi ntambwe.

steps.title: Tangira kwinjiza amafaranga
steps.detail: Turasuzuma tukanakwemeza, akenshi mu masaha 24 kugeza 48. Nyuma y'aho, uba utangiye gukora.

features.heading: Ibyo ukeneye byose, uko ubishaka
features.intro: Byubatswe hakurikijwe uko u Rwanda rugenda koko. Ibiciro bikwiye, ikinyabiziga gikwiye, n'amakuru yuzuye kuva utumije kugeza ugeze aho ujya.
features.multiModalBody: Moto iyo wihuta. Imodoka iyo ushaka kwisanzura. Hilux ku mihanda mibi. Fuso ku mizigo minini. Porogaramu imwe, uburyo bune bwo kugenda.
features.trackingBody: Kurikira umushoferi ku ikarita mu gihe aba aje. Sangiza urugendo rurimo kubaho umuntu wese wizeye.
features.pricingBody: Reba igiciro cyagenwe, hanyuma utange icyo wowe usaba. Nta biciro byiyongera bitunguranye.
features.payBody: MoMo, Airtel, cyangwa amafaranga mu ntoki uha umushoferi. Uburyo ni bumwe.

smartMobility.heading: Rwubakiwe ingendo zibaho ako kanya.
smartMobility.intro: Gukurikirana ako kanya, guhuza mu buryo bwiza, kwemeza vuba, n'ibiciro bisobanutse. Byose bikora inyuma y'urugendo rwawe.

features.title: Gukurikirana ako kanya

features.title: Guhuza mu buryo bwiza

features.title: Kwemeza vuba
features.description: Ubusabe bwinshi bw'ingendo bwemezwa mu kanya gato, ugatangira urugendo vuba.

features.title: Ibiciro bisobanutse
features.description: Reba igiciro cyawe mbere y'uko urugendo rutangira, kugira ngo gutumiza kworohe kandi kibe mu mucyo.

content.value: Iyo ukoresheje imbuga zacu, uba wemeye uburyo busobanuwe muri iyi politiki. Niba utabyemera, ntukoreshe imbuga zacu, porogaramu zacu za telefoni, kandi ntuduhe amakuru yawe.
Iyi Politiki y'ibanga ireba uko dukusanya, dukoresha kandi dusangiza amakuru yawe bwite:

items: Igihe wakiriye ubutumwa bwacu cyangwa witabiriye ibikorwa cyangwa ibirori byacu, biba kuri interineti cyangwa hanze yayo
Igihe wuzuza ifishi yo kwiyandikisha cyangwa kwiyandikisha kuri porogaramu zacu za telefoni
Amakuru tubona ku bandi bantu nk'abacuruzi, abatanga amakuru abitswe, abatangaza ibirimo n'abatanga serivisi

content.value: Turi ushinzwe amakuru ku makuru bwite akusanyirizwa kuri uru rubuga.
Twubahiriza:

items: Itegeko ry'u Rwanda N° 058/2021 ryerekeye kurengera amakuru bwite n'ibanga
Amabwiriza rusange yo kurengera amakuru (GDPR) aho akurikizwa
Andi mabwiriza akurikizwa mu bijyanye n'ubwikorezi na serivisi za digitale

content.title: 3.1  Amakuru bwite
bullets: Amazina yombi
Numero ya telefoni na numero ya mobile money
Aderesi ya imeyili
Ifoto y'umwirondoro
Indangamuntu cyangwa pasiporo (ku bashoferi)
Aho utuye

content.title: 3.2  Amakuru y'aho uri
bullets: Aho uri ako kanya ukurikije GPS mu gihe ukoresha porogaramu
Aho utwarwa n'aho ugezwa
Amateka y'inzira wanyuzemo (ku mpamvu z'umutekano no kunoza serivisi)

content.title: 3.3  Amakuru y'urugendo
bullets: Amateka y'ingendo
Amakuru yo kwishyura (akorwa n'abandi batanga serivisi)
Amanota n'ibitekerezo

content.title: 3.4  Amakuru y'igikoresho n'ikoranabuhanga
bullets: Ubwoko bw'igikoresho na sisitemu ikoreshwa
Aderesi ya IP
Amakuru y'ikoreshwa rya porogaramu n'inyandiko z'amakosa

content.title: 3.5  Amakuru yihariye y'abashoferi
bullets: Amakuru n'ifoto by'uruhushya rwo gutwara
Inyandiko n'ifoto by'iyandikwa ry'ikinyabiziga
Icyemezo n'ifoto by'ubwishingizi
Numero ya kode ya Momo na numero ya telefoni ya mobile money
Amakuru y'igenzura ry'amateka (aho bikenewe)
Amakuru n'ifoto by'uruhushya rwo gutwara abagenzi (aho bikenewe)
Ifoto z'ikinyabiziga cyangwa ibinyabiziga

content.title: 3.6  Ibitekerezo n'ubutumwa
bullets: Amakuru utanga igihe usaba ubufasha, usubiza ibibazo by'ubushakashatsi, cyangwa utwandikira

content.title: 3.7  Amakuru ava ku bandi
bullets: Andi makuru ava ku bandi bantu nk'abatanga serivisi, abagemura, imbuga nkoranyambaga n'ibigo by'ubwamamaza, kugira ngo tuguhe amakuru akubereye kurushaho ku bijyanye na serivisi zacu

items: Guhuza abagenzi n'abashoferi
Gutanga, kubungabunga no kunoza Urubuga na porogaramu za telefoni
Gutunganya no kurangiza ingendo
Gutunganya kwishyura no kwishyura abashoferi
Kunoza umutekano n'imikorere y'urubuga
Gutanga ubufasha ku bakiriya
Kumenya uburiganya no kubuza ikoreshwa nabi
Kubahiriza inshingano zishingiye ku mategeko
Kohereza amakuru y'ingenzi ku serivisi
Gusobanukirwa neza ibyo ukeneye n'ibigushimisha, no guhuza serivisi n'ibyo ukunda
Gutunganya ubusabe bwatanzwe binyuze ku Rubuga no muri porogaramu za telefoni
Gukora isesengura ry'urubuga na serivisi zo gucunga amakuru abitswe
Gucunga no gutanga ubwamamaza bushingiye ku byo ukunda ku mbuga zacu no ku mbuga z'abandi twizeye
Gukora iperereza cyangwa kubuza ivunwa ry'amategeko cyangwa amasezerano ufitanye natwe
Kurengera uburenganzira, ibanga, umutekano cyangwa umutungo wawe, uwacu, cyangwa uw'abandi

content.value: Ntabwo tugurisha amakuru bwite.
Dukoresha amakuru dushingiye kuri ibi:

items: Ibisabwa n'amasezerano: gutanga serivisi z'ingendo no kwishyura
Inshingano zishingiye ku mategeko: kubahiriza imisoro n'amabwiriza y'ubwikorezi
Inyungu zemewe: kurwanya uburiganya, umutekano, n'isesengura
Uruhushya rwawe: ubutumwa bw'ubwamamaza n'ibindi bikorwa udategetswe

content.value: Ntabwo dusangiza amakuru yawe bwite abandi bantu utabyemeye, keretse mu bihe bikurikira:

content.title: Abashoferi, abagenzi n'abatanga serivisi
bullets: Amazina n'aho utwarwa cyangwa ugezwa
Aho urugendo rugeze n'amakuru yo kuguhamagara (ahishwe aho bishoboka)
Amakuru yo kwishyura harimo kode ya MomoPay na numero za mobile money

content.title: Abafatanyabikorwa mu bucuruzi
bullets: Abafatanyabikorwa baguha serivisi tubifatanyije, urutonde rwabo rushobora gutangwa iyo urusabye

content.title: Amategeko, umutekano no kubahiriza amabwiriza
bullets: Inzego za Leta cyangwa abashinzwe kubahiriza amategeko, ku mpamvu zo kurwanya uburiganya no kubahiriza amategeko
Aho amategeko abyemerera, mu rwego rw'iperereza rishingiye ku mategeko
Kurengera, gukora iperereza no kubuza ibikorwa by'uburiganya, ibyangiza cyangwa binyuranyije n'amategeko

content.title: Ihererekanya ry'ubucuruzi
bullets: Mu rwego rw'ihuzwa ry'ibigo, kugurwa, kwivugurura, kugurisha umutungo, cyangwa mu gihe cyo guhomba

items: Amakuru ya konti: abikwa igihe konti yawe ikora
Amateka y'ingendo: kugeza ku myaka 5 (kubahiriza amategeko n'imisoro)
Amakuru y'aho uri: abikwa mu gihe gito, ku mpamvu z'umutekano no gukemura impaka
Amakuru y'ubwamamaza: kugeza igihe uhagarikiye uruhushya wari watanze

content.value: Dushyiraho ingamba zikomeye z'umutekano, zirimo:

items: Kubika amakuru y'ingenzi mu ibanga
Seriveri zizewe n'ibikorwaremezo byo mu kirere
Kugenzura abinjira n'uburyo bwo kwemeza umuntu
Igenzura ry'umutekano rikorwa buri gihe

content.value: Nyamara, nta sisitemu ifite umutekano wa 100%, kandi ntitwakwemeza ko umutekano wuzuye ushoboka.
Itegeko ry'u Rwanda N°058/2021 ryo ku wa 13/10/2021 ryerekeye kurengera amakuru bwite n'ibanga rikuha uburenganzira bukurikira:

items: Kubona: Gusaba amakuru ku byerekeye uko dukoresha amakuru no kubona amakuru yawe bwite
Gukosora: Kuvugurura cyangwa gukosora amakosa mu makuru yawe bwite
Gusiba: Gusaba ko amakuru yawe bwite asibwa
Kwimura: Guhabwa kopi y'amakuru yawe bwite mu buryo mudasobwa ishobora gusoma
Kugabanya: Kugabanya uburyo amakuru yawe bwite akoreshwa
Kwamagana: Kwamagana ko dushingira ku nyungu zemewe mu gukoresha amakuru yawe

content.value: Dukoresha aho uri ukurikije GPS kugira ngo:

items: Duhuze abagenzi n'abashoferi bari hafi
Dukurikirane aho urugendo rugeze
Dunoze umutekano no kuyobora inzira

content.value: Ushobora guhagarika uburenganzira bwo kumenya aho uri mu igenamiterere rya telefoni yawe, ariko serivisi z'ibanze zishobora kudakora neza.

Uru Rubuga ntirugenewe abantu bafite munsi y'imyaka 18, kandi ntabwo tubigambiriye dukusanya cyangwa dusaba amakuru bwite y'umuntu wese uri munsi y'imyaka 18. Niba ufite munsi y'imyaka 18, ntugerageze gukoresha uru Rubuga cyangwa kutwoherereza amakuru akwerekeyeho.
Amakuru yawe ashobora kubikwa cyangwa gutunganyirizwa kuri seriveri ziri hanze y'u Rwanda. Iyo ibyo bibaye, twemeza ko hashyirwaho ingamba zikwiye zihuje n'amahame ya GDPR.
Dushobora gukoresha abandi batanga serivisi mu bijyanye na:

items: Kwishyura
Amakarita no kuyobora inzira
Isesengura
Serivisi z'ubutumwa
Serivisi zo kubika imbuga

content.value: Abo batanga serivisi bafite politiki zabo z'ibanga, kandi turagusaba kuzisoma.
Cookies ni udufayili duto tw'amakuru dushyirwa ku gikoresho cyawe igihe usuye urubuga. Dukoresha ubwoko butandukanye bwa cookies:

items: Cookies za ngombwa rwose: zikenewe kugira ngo Urubuga rukore, kandi ntizishobora guhagarikwa
Cookies z'imikorere: zidufasha kubara abasuye urubuga n'aho baturutse, kugira ngo dupime kandi dunoze imikorere
Cookies z'imikoreshereze: zituma habaho imikorere yisumbuyeho no guhuza urubuga n'ibyo ukunda
Cookies z'abandi: ziva ku batanga isesengura (urugero Google Analytics), zitanga amakuru ku bwoko bw'abakoresha n'uko bakoresha urubuga

content.value: Dushobora kandi gukoresha web beacons (rimwe na rimwe zitwa "tracking pixels" cyangwa "clear gifs"), udufoto duto twemerera kumenya igihe umuntu yasuye Urubuga rwacu. Niba wiyandikishije kwakira imeyili zacu, dushobora gukoresha cookies muri izo meyili.
Muri za mushakisha nyinshi ushobora gusiba cyangwa kwanga cookies. Kugira ngo ubikore, kurikiza amabwiriza ari mu igenamiterere rya mushakisha yawe.

content.title: Imbuga na serivisi by'abandi
bullets: Urubuga rushobora kuba rurimo amahuza yerekeza ku zindi mbuga zicungwa n'abandi
Ntabwo dushinzwe ibyo bakora cyangwa uko bitwara ku bijyanye n'ibanga
Turagusaba gusoma politiki zabo z'ibanga kugira ngo umenye byinshi

content.title: Umutekano
bullets: Dufata ingamba z'imitunganyirize, iz'ikoranabuhanga n'iz'umubiri zo kurinda amakuru yawe bwite
Ibyago by'umutekano biba mu ikoranabuhanga rya interineti n'iry'amakuru muri rusange
Ntitwakwemeza ko amakuru yawe bwite afite umutekano wuzuye
